Class GamepadDeviceManager

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Manages multiple GamepadDevice instances, handling connection state, device claiming, releasing, and tracking last used gamepads.

public sealed class GamepadDeviceManager : InputDeviceBase, IComparable<InputDeviceBase>

Field Value

int

DeviceProcessPriority

The process priority of this gamepad device manager instance.

Change this value to change the order in which this device manager is processed in ShapeInput. Lower priorities are processed first. 

public uint DeviceProcessPriority

Field Value

uint

Remarks

A unique value based on the order of instantiation is assigned per default.

LastUsedGamepad

The most recently used gamepad that registered input during the last update cycle, considering any filters or settings applied via InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings. This is null if no gamepad was used.

public GamepadDevice? LastUsedGamepad

LastUsedGamepads

List of GamepadDevice instances that registered input during the last update cycle, considering any filters or settings applied via InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings. This list is cleared and repopulated on each update.
